name: shield-extension
description: Shield — Screen-level Hiding of Identifiable Elements using Local Detection. Chrome extension client.

scripts.build: npm run verify-models && npm run ort-assets && npm run ocr-assets && npm run icons && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node tools/check-dev-gate.mjs && node tools/check-build.mjs dist
scripts.check: npm run test && tsc --noEmit && npm run build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build && node tools/make-firefox-manifest.mjs && node tools/check-dev-gate.mjs dist-firefox && node tools/check-build.mjs dist-firefox
